dashboard.label: Better Map - OT Purdue Overlay
dashboard.description: v1.6 showcase: OT asset map colored by Purdue / IEC 62443 level (0-5). The Purdue module enriches each feature from a Splunk lookup containing host,asset_id,purdue_level. Demo data fabricates a 2-site plant with Level-0 sensors, Level-1 PLCs, Level-2 SCADA, Level-3 MES, Level-4 ERP, and Level-5 enterprise IT. Replace the inline SPL with your asset register.
